mentions.name: renovate-log-parser
mentions.description: A CLI and UI tool that parses Renovate Bot's debug log to diagnose issues with Renovate Bot. It offers several CLI commands to accelerate the analysis, including a command designed for coding agents to read the log while saving tokens, and can be run via "npx renovate-log-parser".
mentions.problem: Diagnosing issues with Renovate Bot from its debug log is slow and needs acceleration.
mentions.source_excerpt: A CLI and UI tool called "renovate-log-parser" to diagnose issues with Renovate Bot, using its debug log. It's supposed to accelerate this analysis, with several CLI commands (one meant for coding agents to save tokens when they read the log).
mentions.author: mshekow
